_doc: 02 s17.3 account progression (ProgressionDef, R0 B.1 progression.json). Cosmetic and social only (01 s3.4). Server-authoritative (ADR-08). XP curve, mode factors and campaign XP per 02 s17.3; levels[] is the cosmetic unlock table derived from the 02 s17.3 unlock rules. No stat unlocks.

xp_curve._doc: 02 s17.3 XP to go from level L to L+1 = 1000 + 250 * L (summed to the cap: 355,250 XP, '~355,000' in 02)

xp_per_match._doc: 02 s17.3 XP per match = score x mode factor x 1.25 on a win

mode_factor._doc: 02 s17.3 PvP 1.0, Co-op 0.8, Skirmish 0.5; pvp covers pvp_1v1, pvp_2v2, pvp_team (02 s14)

campaign_xp._doc: 02 s17.3 Campaign: 2,000 XP per first clear, +500 silver, +1,000 gold

mission_paints._doc: 02 s17.3 campaign gold medals unlock 8 mission paints (one per mission; 8 missions per R0 C3-10)
